Every implementation and verification gate that is genuinely not done yet keeps its future tense unchanged and is never marked complete by this record: Step 0, the B2a/B2b/B3 implementation and independent review, the owner's exact-head trust-policy attestation, the B3 dry-run/negative/smoke probes, the B4 acceptance gates, and the optional B5 preload retirement. designReview.evidence: Independent read-only design review of ADR 0077 by codex/gpt-6-astra, a reviewer distinct from implementationOwner claude-code. Round 1 at commit 377783ec711a6e772fb19bc35148b4830234e5d8 (same tree as ba6d0128f4732759f9ec3400b398b042f04071c4): verdict ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES, with two P1 findings (F-1: the manifest's own hash inside the pre-built catalog did not externally bind the build-admitted identity; F-2: accepting the catalog silently changed the disposition of a damaged on-disk source after acceptance) and three P2 findings (F-3: the published-digest equivalence claim reached beyond what it measured; F-4: the proposed smoke checks did not prove the packaged executable actually uses the pre-built path; F-5: Step 0 was measurement guidance, not yet an explicit go/no-go gate). Round 2 (re-review) at commit 108bcfb0ec7b4856fcb7423fa6f540d2f23632f4, diffed against ba6d0128f (same tree as the round-1 baseline): verdict ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES with no P1 remaining. F-1 through F-4 were closed at the design level (the manifest-set digest binds the build identity; the owner's Option A damaged-source policy is recorded as an explicit R3 trust-policy decision needing exact-head attestation; source-isolated processes now assert their admission source and cover General Replace parents and on-demand compilation; smoke now requires full pack-to-packaged-JSON correspondence and a headless probe proving admission-source=prebuilt). F-5 was only partially closed. Two P2 findings remained open after round 2: F-6, the disposition matrix labelled every packaged-file change as a JSON-admission failure even though a schema-valid bundleId edit is still JSON-admissible; and F-7, the Step 0 noise test compared only the raw (a)/(b) intervals without adding the one-time acceptance cost and its uncertainty before judging separation from noise. This revision (2b59f8ddd) closes both: the disposition matrix now distinguishes rejected damage from an admissible manifest edit and states the outcome for each, and the Step 0 gate now requires the acceptance-cost-inclusive projected candidate range to lie below the baseline before treating a gain as separated from noise. No P1 finding remains open in either round. On this basis the owner accepted ADR 0077 as decision 46 (2026-09-26): the ADR is accepted after the two independent design reviews, and implementation starts with the Step 0 attribution measurement and continues only past its gate.
